// Compile actual generated refs: exact result, argument, kind, and table inference
// must survive module discovery, aliasing, optional fields, and async void.
import { TokamakClient, type ArgsOf, type ResultOf, type FunctionReference, type Id, type Doc, type ModelFromSchema } from '@tokamak/sdk';
import { api } from '../feature/_generated/api';
import schema from '../feature/schema';
type Equal<A, B> = (<T>() => T extends A ? 1 : 2) extends (<T>() => T extends B ? 1 : 2) ? true : false;
type Assert<T extends true> = T;
type Simplify<T> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] };
export type Kind = Assert<typeof api.tasks.add extends FunctionReference<'mutation', unknown, unknown> ? true : false>;
export type InsertResult = Assert<Equal<ResultOf<typeof api.tasks.add>, Id<'tasks'>>>;
export type VoidResult = Assert<Equal<ResultOf<typeof api.tasks.noResult>, null>>;
export type ListResult = Assert<Equal<ResultOf<typeof api.nested.views.dashboard>['recent'], Doc<ModelFromSchema<typeof schema>, 'tasks'>[]>>;
export type Input = Assert<Equal<Simplify<ArgsOf<typeof api.tasks.edit>>, { id: Id<'tasks'>; done: boolean }>>;
export async function consume(client: TokamakClient) {
  const id: Id<'tasks'> = await client.mutation(api.tasks.add, { title: 'Ship', priority: 2 });
  await client.mutation(api.tasks.add, { title: 'Ship', priority: 2, note: 'soon' });
  const task = await client.query(api.tasks.get, { id });
  if (task) { const title: string = task.title; const note: string | undefined = task.note; return { title, note }; }
  client.subscribe(api.nested.views.dashboard, { done: false, priority: 2 }, event => {
    if ('value' in event) { const done: boolean | undefined = event.value.first?.done; void done; }
  });
}
